source.caveat: conv and code cover different calendar weeks; summed by index so hour-of-day phase aligns, calendar date does not

derived_from.why: EXP-113. Qwen2.5-72B answers are 1.46x longer than Llama-3.1-70B's on this workload, so FluidServe's 90% capacity crossing falls 28.4 -> 18.3 req/s (EXP-112, one repeat). The factor is that ratio, so the hour occupies the same position relative to capacity as the source did on Llama: 0.95x mean against 0.96x, 44% of minutes above the crossing against 45%.
